reading: A real LLM (Kimi), reading the action labels, realises ~97% of the perfect-knowledge oracle's semantic exploitation zero-shot, nearly halving post-shift regret vs the numeric baseline. The LLM's job here is category-membership classification from labels; the bounded belief_delta logic is the oracle's. Value = model world-knowledge injected through the governed belief-only organ (C6/C7 strict parser), i.e. governed model intelligence — the constructive complement of the autonomy-axis foreclosure (value is model capability + governance, not a separable architected axis).
caveats: 3 seeds (bounded live run); tests membership classification accuracy, not LLM-generated deltas; key supplied via env var, never persisted. A fuller paid run would widen seeds and audit the response cache.
key_handling: KIMI_API_KEY read from environment only; not stored in code, result, or git.
